pages.text:
Thandi whizzed on a rollercoaster,
took a bumper car for a spin,
and won a giant,
fluffy bear…
pages.action: Thandi rides a rollercoaster and bumper car and wins a bear
pages.change: Thandi is at a funfair, riding and winning
pages.page_turn_note: The sentence is left open with an ellipsis and finished after the turn.

notes: full-bleed cinematic spread; the won bear rides beside her in the bumper car

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text: …all while she sat in her bedroom.
pages.change: The funfair turns out to be happening in her bedroom
pages.question_created: How was she at the funfair from her bed?
pages.page_turn_note: The pattern (adventure, then a quiet 'but at home' page) is now set; the next turn starts a new child.

notes: split layout: white left half with a single small object (a slipper), picture on the right
illustration.only_in_image: She is reading a book on her bed, cross-legged in pyjamas; the text never says she is reading, only that she sat in her bedroom.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Ndalo swam through forests of kelp and coral,
past a stingray and a majestic shark…
pages.location: under the sea (as the picture shows)
pages.action: Ndalo dives past kelp, a stingray and a shark
pages.change: A second child goes on a second adventure
pages.page_turn_note: Same open ellipsis as page 1; a listener who caught the pattern now predicts the turn.

illustration.only_in_image: He wears full diving gear with mask and air tank, and waves at the reader.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text: …as he lay under a yellowwood tree.
pages.change: The dive was happening while he lay on the grass

notes: split layout with a single leafy sprig on the white half
illustration.only_in_image: He holds an open book against his chest, eyes closed and smiling; the text does not mention a book.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Yohluka rocketed into space on a special
mission to repair a satellite…
pages.action: Yohluka flies to space to repair a satellite
pages.change: A third child goes on a mission

notes: full-bleed space spread; the astronaut's face is hidden behind a reflective visor
illustration.only_in_image: He floats on a tether attached to the spacecraft, high above a planet.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text: …but he was still cuddling on the couch.
pages.location: a couch at home under a blanket
pages.change: The space mission was happening on the couch

notes: split layout with a small lit lamp on the white half
illustration.only_in_image: An older person (age and relation not stated, INFERRED older family member) is reading a book aloud to him under a blanket; the text names only cuddling on the couch.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Faith paraded through the veld,
waving to zebras as an
oxpecker soared above…
pages.action: Faith parades through the veld past zebras
pages.change: A fourth child goes on a safari

notes: full-bleed savanna; an oxpecker flies overhead (the same bird is on the cover and the closing vignette)
illustration.only_in_image: She is riding on an elephant's back with both arms thrown up; the text never mentions the elephant on this spread.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text: …from the safety of Gogo’s warm kitchen.
pages.action: Faith rests her chin on her arms over an open book
pages.change: The safari was happening at Gogo's table
pages.page_turn_note: The pattern ends here; the next turn moves to a new day and a new place.

notes: split layout with a steaming mug on the white half; the right panel repeats the cover image
illustration.only_in_image: The open book in front of her is painted with the same safari she just rode through: an elephant, a zebra, grass and water.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
On Monday morning,
Ms Kani asked the class,

“So, what did you do this weekend?”
pages.action: Ms Kani asks the class about their weekend
pages.change: Time and place jump to Monday at school; the four children will be gathered
pages.question_created: What will they say they did?
pages.page_turn_note: A direct question to the class closes the spread and is answered on the next one.

notes: the teacher gestures towards a large white bubble that holds the words

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
“I drove a car!”
“I swam with a shark!”
“I flew to outer space!”
“I rode an elephant!”
pages.action: The four children each claim an adventure
pages.change: The four separate threads meet in one picture

notes: the four children stand in a row, hands up, each line placed above its speaker
illustration.only_in_image: Which child says which line is shown only by placement; the funfair child claims she drove a car, a stretch of the bumper car ride.

pages.label: INFERRED

pages.text:
Ms Kani laughed.

“It sounds like you’ve been reading again.
Now, which book do you
want to read next?”
pages.location: a collage of all four imagined worlds
pages.action: Ms Kani laughs, names reading as the source, and asks which book is next
pages.change: The secret is named in words: they were reading
pages.question_created: Which book will they read next?
pages.page_turn_note: The closing question hands the choice of the next book to the listener as well.

notes: one spread gathers the satellite, the shark, the stingray, zebras and the elephant over a blue globe
illustration.only_in_image: Faith is still riding the elephant across the sky in the teacher's scene, so the imagined world bursts into the classroom.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.action: Children's hands reach for many open books
pages.change: No words: a choice of new books is laid out
pages.page_turn_note: Wordless last spread; the end of the story is a choice, not a summary.

notes: wordless; books with a turtle, a rocket, a cat, a bee and a fairy on their covers, small hands reaching in from the edges
illustration.only_in_image: The children are choosing their next books from a spread of many; nothing in the text describes this.

pages.label: OBSERVED
